rubrics.justification: The response appropriately noted that no image was available to the model, but it then inferred an estimated 3BB-4BB quality without visual basis. It did not describe actual visible morphology and introduced a speculative grade.

It integrated age, AMH, oocyte yield, BMI, prior cycle, sperm data, endometrium, and lifestyle factors reasonably well, linking them to prognosis and embryo selection limits. Some assumptions were speculative but overall integration was strong.

The structure was logical and the prognosis estimate was explained, but several adjustments were somewhat arbitrary and there were unsupported assumptions (e.g., average BB grade, implantation factor after one failed cycle, alcohol effect magnitude).

Some recommendations were evidence-based, but others were not guideline-supported for routine use, including ERA after a single failed cycle, intralipids/NK-cell testing, thrombophilia screening without indication, and low-dose aspirin as a general adjunct.

The response gave clear practical next steps for transfer management, lifestyle modification, and future cycle planning. However, some suggested interventions were not appropriately selective or evidence-based.
